name: Public Web Applications MUST sit behind a Web Application Firewall (WAF) in Blocking Mode to stop common automated attacks.
requirementTitle: Public Web Applications MUST sit behind a Web Application Firewall (WAF) in Blocking Mode to stop common automated attacks.
requirementDescription: Any website or web application accessible from the internet must be protected by a Web Application Firewall (WAF), and the WAF must be actively blocking malicious traffic rather than just monitoring it.
why:
Many attacks are:
- Automated
- Opportunistic
- Well known
Attackers don't necessarily target DfE specifically.
Instead, they scan the internet looking for vulnerable applications. A WAF provides an additional layer of defence
